          # Test Environment for Generative AI classroom labs

          This lab provides a test environment for the codes generated using the Generative AI classroom.

          Follow the instructions below to set up this environment for further use.

          Test Environment for Generative AI classroom labs¶

          This lab provides a test environment for the codes generated using the Generative AI classroom.

          Follow the instructions below to set up this environment for further use.

          # Setup

          ### Dataset URL from the GenAI lab

          Dataset URL from the GenAI lab¶

          Use the URL provided in the GenAI lab in the cell below.

          [ ]:
          import pandas as pd

          # Path to the CSV file; assume the first row contains headers
          csv_file = 'dataset.csv'

          # Read the CSV file into a DataFrame. Headers are read from the first row by default
          df = pd.read_csv(csv_file)

          # Generate descriptive statistics for all columns, including object data types
          description = df.describe(include='all')

          # Print the resulting statistical description
          print(description)
